statement: For every m=2^s with s at least1 and every coefficient prime, the nontrivial procyclic subgroups of the four-cusp curve v^2=w^(2m)-1 with open arithmetic normalizer are exactly the nontrivial subgroups of cusp inertia conjugates. Together with A.44 this completes both Task A.5 assertions for the whole two-power dihedral family, including the formerly displayed m=8, ell=17 case.
